statements.text: Impression: right-sided lumbar radiculopathy secondary to L3-L4 disc herniation causing foraminal stenosis.
CT lumbar spine 09/12/2026: L3-L4 disc herniation with moderate right foraminal stenosis contacting the exiting nerve root.
Function: unable to stand long enough to cook a meal, has stopped driving because of the pain.
Baseline NRS prior to any intervention: 9/10.
Symptoms began on 08/18/2026, 6 weeks before this visit.
PT discharge summary: completed 8 weeks of physical therapy (07/30/2026 to 09/24/2026) without meaningful improvement; ibuprofen 600 mg TID for the same period without relief.
Continues the daily home exercise program taught in PT.
Denies fever, chills, weight loss, or bowel or bladder changes; no history of cancer.
Epidural steroid injection history: 4 lumbar injections in the past 12 months (11/14/2025, 05/10/2026, 05/31/2026, 07/29/2026).
